summary.en: An unseen input arrives, its letters resolve through the corpus’s own letters, the learned rules replay on it one a beat, and the reveal names the pieces, read in a pause.
summary.zh: 一个没见过的输入进来，字母在语料自己的字母里滚动后锁定，学到的规则一拍一条重放在它身上，揭晓时说出它被拆成的片段，停一拍读。

fits: The climax of a mechanism explainer: proof that the method works on a case it never saw.
notFor: Runs with no rules to replay; a probe longer than a board row.

intent.en: Proof that the method generalises: an input the run never saw is split by the rules it learned, one a beat, and the pieces are named.
intent.zh: 证明方法能推广：一个运行从没见过的输入，被学到的规则一拍一条地拆开，再给出拆成的几块。

content.en: The run with a probe word (≤ 12 chars, code), a caption (≤ 64 / 24 字 with markup), a reveal line.
content.zh: 带探针词的运行（≤ 12 字符，代码），说明（含标记 ≤ 64 字符 / 24 字），揭晓一行。

fits.zh: 机制讲解的高潮：证明方法对没见过的情况也有效。

notFor.zh: 没有可回放规则的运行；比板子一行还长的探针。

en: Pick a probe the rules actually split into learned pieces; one that stays in letters proves nothing.
zh: 探针要真能被规则拆成学到的片段；拆不动的探针什么也证明不了。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
